w: In the Sunday assembly the Surat Satsang Mandal had organised a wonderful drama describing the divinity and glory of the Swaminarayan Mahamantra. In conclusion Swamishri addressed the 12,000 devotees and dignitaries, "If one chants the Swaminarayan mantra with faith, then one attains success in one’s work... The glory of this mantra is such that even if an ant or any living thing hears this mantra will be blessed with a better after-life..."

This morning, during Swamishri’s meeting hours, a teenager (kishore) asked a couple of questions. Kishore: "I always desire to impress people and I know it is wrong." Swamishri: "One should not have such desires. If you perform good acts and have character in life then automatically people will be impressed by you. If you are good then people will not say otherwise." Kishore: "Sometimes I do bad things." Swamishri: "When you desire to impress anyone you will feel like doing bad things. So one must have character and live by God’s laws. If you have good character then people will appreciate you and you will not think of doing bad things." The kishore appreciated Swamishri’s counsel.

In the evening, before his schedule to the assembly, a lot of dignitaries had visited Swamishri. Swamishri was already late for the assembly. The organisers wished Swamishri to come straight to the assembly, but on passing the mandir steps, Swamishri wished to go for Thakorji’s darshan. Swamishri expressed his wish to a sadhu. "I’d like to go for darshan. It’ll take only two minutes!" Swamishri went to the assembly after having the darshan of Thakorji.

Under the auspices of the Swaminarayan Mahamantra Bicentenary Celebration the Surat Satsang Mandal had organised a unique 1½ hr drama on the glory and power of the Swaminaryan Mahamantra for the evening assembly. Every inch of the mandir complex was packed with 12,000 devotees.

"The glory of this mantra is such that even if an ant or any living thing hears this mantra, it will be blessed with a better after-life. So, by saying this mantra in one’s house, while walking the streets, or travelling by car, plane - and whoever hears this, understands and appreciates it, will be blessed with redemption..."

During Swamishri's puja, sadhus sang bhajans in praise and glory of Bhagwan Swaminarayan. Thereafter in the morning assembly Pujya Shrutiprakash Swami, Pujya Vivkesagar Swami and Pujya Doctor Swami delivered discourses. Then Swamishri blessed the assembly. Shri Harikrishna Maharaj was honored by devotees.

At 7.30 p.m., the celebration assembly was arranged on the the mandir site. Pujya Brahmadarshan Swami spoke on the mission of Shriji Maharaj's birth on earth. The balaks and kishores of Savarkundla performed a beautiful dance on the bhajan 'Guru Roon Ada Kem Kariye..." Pujya Viveksagar Swami discoursed about the life, work and philosophy of Bhagwan Swaminarayan. Then Swamishri was honored with the sanctified garlands prepared by the local devotees. The balaks and kishores of Savarkundla performed another dance in honor of Shriji Maharaj on the bhajan, "Chaitra Sud Navmi Avi..." Finally Swamishri blessed the festival assembly, "God has always kept on incarnating on earth to protect us and reestablish dharma. Similarly in Kaliyug Bhagwan Swaminarayan incarnated on earth. He had harboured no distinctions of high or low and nourished feelings to redeem all. He established mandirs for the propagation and consolidation of upasana and dharma. From this we learn about our culture and character. Without a place one cannot worship God. And that is why He built mandirs so that thousands of people could congregrate to worship and pray to God... Alongwith mandirs, He also propagated the glory of shastras like Veda, Upanishad, Gita, Mahabharat, Bhagwat, Ramayan and others. Bhagwan Swaminarayan gave the Satsangijivan, Vachanamrut and Shikshapatri for the good of all... Bhagwan Swaminarayan transformed the lives of evil people and made them into devotees..." Thereafter Swamishri performed pujan and arti of Thakorji and rocked Thakorji in a decorated cradle while the sadhus sang devotional bhajans. The festival assembly was attended by 9,000 devotees and wellwishers.

At 9.30 a.m. Swamishri arrived to inaugurate the newly built section to the Swaminarayan English Medium School catering to students from grade 1 to 7. After performing the pujan of the entrance door, Swamishri inaugurated the school. Thereafter Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha of Shri Akshar Purushottam Maharaj and Guru Parampara at the mandir in the school prayer hall. Thereafter Swamishri blessed the assembly, "There is a great need for education today. The more the availability of education the more peace there will be in our country. An illiterate person cannot think or work properly. Education provides progress so there should be efforts to augment educational services. Here we have constructed a school with all facilities so that children can study properly. They will receive value-based education that will prepare a virtuous society..."
Swamishri performed the pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti of Shri Akshar Purushottam Maharaj, Guru Parampara, Hanumanji and Ganapatiji for the hari mandir in Kathlal.
A youth came for darshan. Asking Pramukh Swami Maharaj for blessings, he said, "My mother and father quarrel a lot, so please bless them that both their natures improve."

Swamishri questioned him, saying, "Why? Do the two of them have an estate to divide? Whether you count mother or father, both are one, aren't they! Then why should they quarrel?" Swamishri said a great deal through his question alone.
A young man came for darshan. Asking Swamishri for blessings, he said, "Mummy and Papa quarrel a lot. Please bless them so that both their natures improve."

Swamishri asked him, "Why? Are the two of them dividing an estate? Whether you call them Mummy or Papa, they are one, aren't they! Then why would they quarrel?" In the question itself Swamishri said a great deal.
Today, as he was going to rest after breakfast, Mahant Swami Maharaj said, "I am Keshavjivandas, the servant of all."
At these sudden, unimagined words, the sadhus fell still.
The attendant sadhu said, "But you are everyone's guru!"
Swamishri said, "There is great joy in being a servant. If one becomes the father, one troubles oneself and troubles others too."
